props.title: New Article: One Word in a Config File. Ten Brains Behind It.

props.text: MiroShark's autonomous agent ran on a single LLM provider for 193 days — until a one-word config change unlocked a 10-provider gateway cascade. The article explains what LLM gateways are, why the industry considers single-provider lock-in an architectural liability, and how a 56× cost difference between the cheapest and most expensive provider path makes multi-model routing not just a cost optimization but a survival mechanism for autonomous agents.
